Provenance: the two lines between the title and the permission notice are the
font's declaration, quoted verbatim from the section
'[SECTION] Default font data (ProggyClean.ttf)'
of Dear ImGui's imgui_draw.cpp (ThirdParty/UI/imgui, pinned in
ThirdParty/supply-chain.lock), which embeds the font in every binary that links
Dear ImGui; docs/FONTS.md at that revision also lists the font as MIT License.
The permission notice is the MIT License text as distributed with Dear ImGui
(imgui-LICENSE.txt). The font project's own license file is not vendored in
this repository.
